name: Green dragons

variantInfo.name: Green dragon
notes: Krystilia assigns green dragons only in the Wilderness; the non-Wilderness greens (Myths' Guild, etc.) do not count for the task.
Green dragons use melee and short-ranged dragonfire; bring dragonfire protection such as an anti-dragon shield and an antifire potion.
Multiple Wilderness spawns exist: north of Graveyard of Shadows (5 spawns), south of the Lava Maze (5 spawns), west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (3 spawns), and the Boneyard area.

locationComparison.name: Graveyard of Shadows (green dragons)
notes: 5 green dragon spawns north of the Graveyard of Shadows.
In the Wilderness (around levels 18-21); a popular player-killing area.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness green dragon spawns
notes: Other Wilderness green dragon clusters: south of the Lava Maze (5 spawns), west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (3 spawns), and the Boneyard.
All are in the Wilderness; multi/cannon status is not wiki-stated, so treated conservatively.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 259 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Green dragons is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns green dragons as a Wilderness-only task; only Wilderness green dragon kills count.
Green dragons use melee and short-ranged dragonfire; bring an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield plus an antifire potion.
Green dragons have low defence and are killed quickly with any strong weapon; dragonbane gear is optional.
Green dragons are weak to water spells (50%).
Wilderness green dragon spots are popular player-killing areas; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose and keep a one-click teleport ready.
recommendedMethod: Take a Krystilia Wilderness green dragon spawn (Graveyard of Shadows or south of the Lava Maze), wear dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield plus antifire), and use a fast melee or ranged weapon such as Viggora's chainmace or Craw's bow. Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
